name: Epic VR Drone Flight Through Fireworks
summary:
Experience fireworks from a breathtaking new perspective. A drone takes you on a spectacular VR journey straight through a real fireworks show above a beautiful lake. Rockets, sparkling trails, and brilliant explosions race past you while their vibrant colors reflect across the water below.

But the spectacle doesn't end there. At the very same time, a second major fireworks display launches from a nearby hillside behind the crowd. From the air, you can witness both performances together as they illuminate
